round.description: Author and pre-check rounds start at 1; round 3 escalates a dispute to a person.

preparation_manifest_digest.description: Controlled preparation basis; absent for historical legacy runs.

label.description: Short label the runner writes for the office view. Never raw model text.

lease_expires_at.description: While running: when the claim lapses unless the daemon renews it with a log post.

requeue_of.description: The run this one was requeued from, after it was lost, failed or stopped.

requeued_as.description: The run the owner queued to replace this one.

stop_requested_at.description: The owner asked to stop this run. It shows as stopping until the daemon confirms.

waiting_reason.description: Why a queued run is not being handed out, in plain words.

independence_override.description: The owner let this pre-check run on the author's runtime. Recorded before it ran.

generation.description:
Which attempt this is at its package revision, role and round, counting from 1. Reports from an
attempt a later one superseded are refused (the generation fence, specification 22).

receipt.description: The process the daemon spawned for this run, as it recorded it at spawn.

outcome_unknown.description:
Set when the run was dispatched but its exit or completion was never observed (specification
9 and 22). It holds requeue until a reconciliation records what happened.

reconciliation.description: What settled an unknown outcome, and the evidence for it.

description: One agent session working on one package revision in one role.
